query: How should a leave request be submitted?

before_rerank.text: Parking permits must be renewed annually before the end of the month.
Employees may take up to 20 days of paid annual leave each year.
Performance reviews are scheduled annually for all managers in November.
Leave requests should be submitted to a manager at least two weeks in advance.
All employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave annually on January 1st.
Primary caregivers are eligible for up to 16 consecutive weeks of fully paid parental leave.
